events.name: Atlanta Braves at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Gerrit Cole pitched seven strong innings and outdueled Chris Sale in a matchup of Cy Young Award winners as the New York Yankees beat the Atlanta Braves 5-4 Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cole outduels Sale in matchup of Cy Young winners as Yankees beat Braves 5-4

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Miami Marlins

headlines.description: — Sandy Alcantara struck out eight in seven innings, becoming the Miami Marlins' career leader in innings pitched, and Xavier Edwards had three RBI in a 7-0 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alcantara becomes Marlins' career leader in innings pitched in a 7-0 victory over the Angels

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — The Boston Red Sox failed in their bid for a second winning streak of 10 or more games in the same season, losing to the Athletics 7-3 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox bid for 2nd win streak of 10 or more games ends in 7-3 loss to Athletics

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Nathan Lukes hit a two-run home run in the 11th inning and the Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Philadelphia Phillies 7-5 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lukes hits 2-run HR in 11th, Scherzer into 10th place all-time in Ks as Blue Jays beat Phillies7-5

events.name: New York Mets at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Bubba Chandler allowed three hits in six innings, Jake Mangum had three hits and the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the New York Mets 9-0 on Saturday night to end a four-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chandler cruises through 6 innings as Pirates beat Mets 9-0 to end 4-game skid

headlines.description: — Andrés Chaparro drove in three runs and the Washington Nationals snapped Cincinnati ace Chase Burns’ 12-game winning streak, beating the Reds 8-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nationals snap Cincinnati ace Chase Burns’ 12-game winning streak, beating Reds 8-2

events.name: Chicago Cubs at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — The Royals made Clay Holmes' debut with the Chicago Cubs a forgettable affair Saturday night, hammering him for four runs in his return from the injured list, while Jac Calgianone helped to power Kansas City to a 6-3 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jac Caglianone powers the Royals past Chicago 6-3 as Clay Holmes makes a shaky debut for the Cubs

headlines.description: — Andrew Vaughn singled home the tiebreaking run in the eighth inning as the Milwaukee Brewers edged the Minnesota Twins 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Andrew Vaughn knocks home go-ahead run in 8th inning as Brewers defeat Twins 4-3

headlines.description: — Jacob deGrom struck out nine over five innings for his first victory in more than a month and the Texas Rangers beat Baltimore 5-1 on Saturday night for their fourth consecutive victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jacob deGrom strikes out 9 and Rangers beat Orioles for 4th win in a row

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Munetaka Murakami homered and Tristan Peters and Chase Meidroth each drove in a pair of runs in Chicago's five-run sixth inning as the White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 6-3 Saturday, snapping a season-worst four-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murakami HR, Peters, Meidroth each knock in 2 runs as White Sox top Guardians to end 4-game skid

events.name: Colorado Rockies at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Jake McCarthy homered twice in a four-hit night, Cole Carrigg and TJ Rumfield each had two hits and the Colorado Rockies beat the St. Louis Cardinals 8-6 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake McCarthy homers twice as the Rockies get past the Cardinals, 8-6

events.name: Detroit Tigers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Jackson Jobe held the San Francisco Giants to one hit in five scoreless innings in his first outing in the majors more than a year and the Detroit Tigers broke it open with a six-run seventh inning in an 8-0 victory Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Jobe has sparkling debut to help the Tigers rout the Giants 8-0

events.name: Houston Astros at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill hit his 17th home run of the season to help the San Diego Padres beat the Houston Astros 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Merrill's home run helps Padres beat Astros 3-2

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Shohei Ohtani brought home the go-ahead run in the 10th inning on an infield single and the Los Angeles Dodgers snapped a seven-game losing streak by beating the Arizona Diamondbacks 2-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ohtani's RBI infield single in the 10th helps Dodgers snap 7-game skid, beat D-backs 2-1

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Richie Palacios hit a two-run single in the sixth inning, Victor Mesa Jr. homered and the Tampa Bay Rays' bullpen held on for a 3-2 victory over the Seattle Mariners on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Richie Palacio, Victor Mesa Jr. lead the Rays past the Mariners, 3-2
